{{dropinitial|T}}{{sc|he}} holy Bible long {{ls}}ince tran{{ls}}lated by vs into Engli{{ls}}h, and the old Te{{ls}}tament lying by vs for lacke of good meanes to publi{{ls}}h the vvhole in {{ls}}uch {{ls}}ort as a vvorke of {{ls}}o great charge and importance requireth: vve haue yet through Gods goodnes at length fully fini{{ls}}hed for thee (mo{{ls}}t Chri{{ls}}tian reader) all the {{sc|Nevv Te{{ls}}tament,}} vvhich is the principal, mo{{ls}}t profitable & comfortable peece of holy vvritte: and, as vvel for all other in{{ls}}titution of life and doctrine, as {{ls}}pecially for deciding the doubtes of the{{ls}}e daies, more propre and pregnant then the other part not yet printed.

{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=Tran{{ls}}lation of the Scriptures into the vulgar tōgues, not ab{{ls}}olutely nece{{ls}}{{ls}}arie or profitable, but according to the time.}}Vvhich tran{{ls}}lation vve doe not for all that publi{{ls}}h, vpon erroneous opinion of nece{{ls}}{{ls}}itie, that the holy Scriptures {{ls}}hould alvvaies be in our mother tonge, or that they ought, or vvere ordained by God, to be read indifferently of all, or could be ea{{ls}}ily vnder{{ls}}tood of euery one that readeth or heareth them in a knovven language: or that they vvere not often through mans malice or infirmitie, pernicious and much hurtful to many: or that vve generally and ab{{ls}}olutely deemed it more conuenient in it {{ls}}elf, & more agreable to Gods word and honour or edification of the faithful, to haue them turned into vulgar tonges, then to be kept & {{ls}}tudied only in the Eccle{{ls}}ia{{ls}}tical learned languages: Not for the{{ls}}e nor any {{ls}}uch like cau{{ls}}es doe vve tran{{ls}}late this {{ls}}acred booke, but vpon {{ls}}pecial con{{ls}}ideration of the pre{{ls}}ent time, {{ls}}tare, and condition of our countrie, vnto vvhich, diuers thinges are either nece{{ls}}{{ls}}arie, or profitable and medicinable novv, that othervvi{{ls}}e in the peace of the Church vvere neither much requi{{ls}}ite, nor perchance vvholy tolerable.
